description: This file defines the SleepMode class, which extends DSConstant, for managing sleep modes in device settings. It declares constants for different sleep modes and provides methods to access instances based on ID or name, as well as retrieving all sleep modes.

classes.name: SleepMode
classes.description: Class representing different sleep modes for device settings, extending DSConstant, providing methods for instantiation and retrieval of sleep mode instances.

methods.name: SleepMode::getInstance
methods.description: Returns a reference to a SleepMode instance based on the provided ID or name.

methods.name: SleepMode::getSleepModes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all available SleepMode instances.

methods.name: SleepMode destructor
methods.description: Handles cleanup for SleepMode instances upon destruction.

ctags.name: kDeepSleep
ctags.pattern: /^	static const int kDeepSleep;   \/\/!< Indicates deep sleep mode.$/

ctags.name: kLightSleep
ctags.pattern: /^	static const int kLightSleep;  \/\/!< Indicates light sleep mode.$/

ctags.name: kMax
ctags.pattern: /^	static const int kMax;         \/\/!< Indicates maximum number of sleep modes supported.$/
